name: Verify qBittorrent auth
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import http.cookiejar
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
module=ast.parse(Path('docker-data/data/config.py').read_text())
assignment=next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and getattr(node.target, 'id', None) == 'config')
config=ast.literal_eval(assignment.value)
client=config['TORRENT_CLIENTS']['qbittorrent']
base=f"{client['qbit_url']}:{client['qbit_port']}"
jar=http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
login=urllib.request.Request(base + '/api/v2/auth/login', data=urllib.parse.urlencode({'username': client.get('qbit_user',''), 'password': client.get('qbit_pass','')}).encode(), method='POST')
try:
    with opener.open(login, timeout=10) as response:
        login_status=response.status
        login_body=response.read().decode(errors='replace').strip()
    authenticated = login_status in (200, 204) and login_body in ('', 'Ok.')
    version_status=None
    version_present=False
    if authenticated:
        with opener.open(base + '/api/v2/app/version', timeout=10) as response:
            version_status=response.status
            version_present=bool(response.read().decode(errors='replace').strip())
    print(f'login_status={login_status} login_ok={authenticated} version_status={version_status} version_present={version_present}')
except Exception as exc:
    print(f'qbit_check_error={type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
PY
REMOTE
description: Confirm Destiny’s qBittorrent authentication and API availability, accepting the server’s 204 login response.
